es.algorithm: antithetic OpenAI-ES: members theta +- sigma * eps_i (eps_i ~ N(0, I), i < pairs) plus the center every generation; per-parameter sigma

disqualification.rule: a member's world-episode disqualifies when it dies and A0 does not, when r_end < x * r_start and A0's does not, or when a consumer's fill < y and A0 does not starve that consumer (per consumer), A0 on the same world-episode and keys (the bar's A0 row); one disqualifying world-episode -> the member takes the worst rank

es.estimate: g_j = sum_i (r(+i) - r(-i)) * eps_ij / (2 * pairs * sigma_j)

fitness.B_we: max over RR, MWW (R = 2 mean), TR and the roster v2 deterministic members (bar.csv)
fitness.D_we: mean scheduled consumer demand per cycle (bar.csv)
fitness.formula: f = mean over the minibatch of U / B_we - h * H / D_we

es.noise: eps of generation g: numpy default_rng(int(sha256('|'.join([noise_stream, 'train', opt_seed, g]))[:16], 16)).standard_normal((pairs, n_params))
es.nonfinite: a member whose policy raises NonFiniteChoice takes the worst rank and is logged; never a contract failure
es.rank_shaping: centered ranks over the 2 * pairs members (rank / (2 pairs - 1) - 0.5, average ranks on ties); disqualified and non-finite members share the worst rank; the center is not ranked
es.static_clip_42_stop: a real ES run (probe or train) refuses a bar whose normaliser.json flags static_psi_clip_42 (a 42-producer static count pinned at the clip); the run stops and goes to the supervisor
es.update: Adam ascending g - weight_decay * theta (L2 coupled into the gradient, OpenAI-ES l2coeff)

normaliser.fit_rows: A0's unnormalised rows (after the input transforms) on the training world-episodes of the bar precompute only (horizon 100, agent-history mode, after the infeasible-world replacement): one phi row per (decision, eligible producer), one psi row per decision
normaliser.scale_floor_rule: a floored column's scale = max(the rule's scale, its floor); floor of psi.eligible_producer_count = log1p(4) - log1p(2), the spread of its two 12-producer values
normaliser.transform_rule: the listed columns are log1p-transformed before the fit and before every apply (policy and fit rows alike); the rest enter raw
normaliser.zero_spread_rule: IQR = 0 -> the column's population std; std = 0 -> 1.0 (all-equal values have std 0 exactly)

probe.cosine: cosine between the two minibatches' estimates; an all-zero estimate leaves it undefined, read as no_signal
probe.estimate: per minibatch, the training estimate (centered ranks over that minibatch's member fitness); noise from noise_stream with ('probe', arm)
probe.theta: each arm's registered initial theta (A1: 0; A2: w = 0, theta_tau = 0, u ~ N(0, 0.1) seed 0, v = 0), so Delta = 0 for both
probe.variance_ratio: var of paired (same minibatch) f(+i) - f(-i) over var of unpaired f_1(+i) - f_2(-i), f_2(+i) - f_1(-i) (ddof 1, raw fitness, non-finite members excluded); reported
